name: Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 1LE
description: The Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 1LE is the most extreme production Camaro ever built, designed for track day performance with the ability to readjust for the drive home. The sixth-generation Camaro features a lightweight yet ultra-strong architecture with a precisely tuned suspension that keeps the driver connected to the road. At its heart is the supercharged 6.2-liter LT4 V8 producing 650 horsepower and 650 lb-ft of torque. The 1LE track package adds adjustable front camber and ride height via Multimatic DSSV dampers, an adjustable rear stabilizer bar, a fixed carbon-fiber rear wing, and dive planes on the front fascia for increased downforce. With a 0-100 km/h time of 3.8 seconds and a top speed of 310 km/h, the ZL1 1LE delivers supercar performance in a muscle car package.
author: JustKapi
